extracted.intended_audience: Researchers, institutions, and organizations seeking NIFA competitive grants (universities, tribal colleges, extension services, nonprofits, farmers, and other applicants)
extracted.subtask_description: A directory/listing of current and recent National Institute of Food and Agriculture (NIFA) Notices of Funding Opportunity (NOFOs) showing program name, open/closed status, posted and closing dates, assistance listing numbers, and a short description of each program's purpose and priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Listing metadata fields shown on page — status, dates, and pagination
rubrics_metrics.description: Each NOFO listing shows Open/Closed status, Posted Date, and Closing Date; page includes pagination controls (Previous, page numbers, Next, Last).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users should note status (Open vs Closed), check Posted and Closing Dates for deadlines, and use pagination to find additional NOFOs on other pages. This metadata is essential for determining eligibility windows and application timing.
